# A Crown Offered
# to: leader of the Grey Ford Confederation; hist: Highsun 1750; checkpoint 4
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.32
	title = zin_eindil.32.t
	desc = zin_eindil.32.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_crown_offered
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.32.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_eindil.32.a_tip
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = zin_eindil_refused_crown
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_country = {
						has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_refused_crown }
						NOT = { original_tag = ROOT }
						check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > -0.001 }
					}
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_refused_crown }
						check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > -0.001 }
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								original_tag = GNW
								original_tag = GIR
							}
						}
					}
					country_event = {
						id = zin_eindil.32
						days = 3
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_global_flag = zin_eindil_stage_3_done
				if = {
					limit = {
						zin_eindil_historical = yes
					}
					set_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.32.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_eindil.32.b_tip
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_role = 2 }
			zin_eindil_set_host = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_event = 1 }
			zin_west_on_war_king = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_west_add_unity = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
			}
			add_ideas = zin_eindil_war_kings_banner
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
					NOT = { original_tag = PREV }
				}
				give_military_access = PREV
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_eindil_confed_member
				}
				country_event = zin_eindil.156
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						original_tag = GNW
						original_tag = GIR
					}
				}
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.33
					days = 60
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					zin_eindil_has_host = yes
				}
				var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
					country_event = {
						id = zin_eindil.34
						days = 365
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Landfall in the Frozen North
# to: owner of zin_is_site_yeldenne_landing; hist: Sowing 1753
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.70
	title = zin_eindil.70.t
	desc = zin_eindil.70.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_landfall
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = zin_afrit_at_yeldenne
			}
			hidden_effect = { zin_afrit_resolve_seat = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_event_target = zin_afrit_seat
				}
				event_target:zin_afrit_seat = {
					country_event = zin_afrit.33
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = zin_afrit_sent_others
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_yeldenne_landing = yes }
						any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_yeldenne = yes }
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
					}
				}
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.71
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_yeldenne_landing = yes }
						any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_yeldenne = yes }
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
					}
				}
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.71
					days = 7
				}

		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.70.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes

				add = 5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.70.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}

# The Ambush
# to: the owner of the landing, the owner of Mp'E, and the Worshipdom (private variants); hist: Sowing 1753
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.71
	title = zin_eindil.71.t
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.71.d_hub_fail
		trigger = {
			zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
			check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.71.d_hub_few
		trigger = {
			zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
			check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
			NOT = {
				zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
				check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.71.d_hub
		trigger = {
			zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
					}
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.71.d_fail
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
					}
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
					}
					zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.71.d_few
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
					}
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
					}
					zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
					check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.71.d
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
					}
					AND = {
						zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
					}
					zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
					check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
					check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_landfall_b
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_at_yeldenne
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_sent_others
		}
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_let_land }
	}
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_71_done }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_71_done
			zin_eindil_compute_ambush = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength }
			zin_eindil_ambush_resolved = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength > 3.999 }
				}
				set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 1 }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_yeldenne = yes }
					}
					country_event = {
						id = zin_eindil.72
						days = 1
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_strength > 1.999 }
					}
					set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 2 }
					set_global_flag = zin_eindil_companions_live
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.zin_eindil_ambush_result = 3 }
					set_global_flag = zin_eindil_ambush_failed
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.71.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.71.b
		trigger = {
			zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

			}

		}
	}

		text = zin_eindil.90.d
		trigger = {

				has_global_flag = zin_eindil_quiet_return
			}
		}
	}
	picture = GFX_zin_news_beat_dragon_wings
	major = yes
	# K61: shown to the lands where it happens and the realms it involves (data/news_reach.json).
	show_major = {
		OR = {
			zin_hears_in_middle_lands = yes
			zin_hears_in_north_lands = yes
			check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
		}
	}
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_se_saw_heir_returns } } # super event 12 replaces this news for the players who saw it (K60, modules/super_events.mjs)
	timeout_days = 30
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_90_done }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_90_done
			if = {
				limit = {
					zin_eindil_has_host = yes
				}
				var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
					country_event = {
						id = zin_eindil.91
						days = 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = ZOL
				}
				ZOL = {
					country_event = {
						id = zin_eindil.91
						days = 1
					}
				}
			}
			zin_eindil_pick_host_candidate = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host_candidate
				}
				var:global.zin_eindil_host_candidate = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							exists = yes
						}
						country_event = {
							id = zin_eindil.92
							days = 1
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.90.a
		trigger = {
			NOT = { zin_is_volgan = yes }
			NOT = { zin_is_zol = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.90.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				zin_is_volgan = yes
				zin_is_zol = yes
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
}

# Volgan at the Southern Front
# to: the Host, Volgan and the friends of the Host; hist: 1 Highsun 1757
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.96
	title = zin_eindil.96.t
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.96.d_host
		trigger = {
			zin_eindil_is_host = yes
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.96.d_volgan
		trigger = {
			zin_is_volgan = yes
			NOT = {
				zin_eindil_is_host = yes
			}
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.96.d
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zin_eindil_is_host = yes
					zin_is_volgan = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_battles
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_96_done }
				zin_eindil_is_host = yes
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_eindil_96_done
			zin_eindil = {
				add_timed_unit_leader_trait = {
					trait = zin_eindil_struck_down
					days = 60
				}
			}
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_eindil_heir_has_fallen days = 60 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = PUV
				}
				PUV = {
					country_event = zin_dominion.16
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = PUV
				}
				PUV = {
					country_event = zin_eindil.96
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
					NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes }
				}
				country_event = zin_eindil.96
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					zin_eindil_zol_in_field = yes
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_varner_dead }
				}
				set_global_flag = zin_varner_dead
				zin_super_event_varner_falls = yes # super event 13 (modules/super_events.mjs)
				zin_world_raise_varners_wards = yes
				set_country_flag = zin_golbran_spent
				retire_character = zin_varner
				retire_character = zin_golbran
				country_event = zin_eindil.97
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = MAG
					}
					MAG = {
						country_event = zin_eindil.97
					}
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
						NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes }
					}
					country_event = zin_eindil.97
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.96.a
		trigger = {
			zin_eindil_is_host = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_eindil.96.a_tip
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 }
					}
				}
				zin_eindil_lose_heir = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.96.b
		trigger = {
			zin_is_volgan = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.96.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = { zin_eindil_is_host = yes }
			NOT = { zin_is_volgan = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
}

		name = zin_eindil.111.a

			base = 70

				add = 30
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }

				limit = {

						id = zin_eindil.113
						days = 180

		}

			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					zin_eindil_has_host = yes

	id = zin_eindil.159
	title = zin_eindil.159.t
	desc = zin_eindil.159.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_stay_and_rule_b
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.159.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 80
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
			zin_eindil_add_delay = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.159.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
		}
	}
}

# What Lorien Will Not Say
# to: the Gala Elves; hist: Rainwake 1752
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.160
	title = zin_eindil.160.t
	desc = zin_eindil.160.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_lorien_gift
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.160.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = zin_mirror_stilled
				}
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.52
					days = 75
				}
			}
			else = {
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.52
					days = 15
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}

# Master Ilsabet's Rolls
# to: the country that employs Master Ilsabet (Aenor at the start); hist: Rainwake 1754
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.165
	title = zin_eindil.165.t
	desc = zin_eindil.165.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_selen_shore_b
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	trigger = {
		has_character = zin_aldovan
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.165.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 50
				OR = {
					has_government = democratic
					has_government = neutrality
				}
				NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_eindil.165.a_tip
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_aldovan } } zin_aldovan = { set_nationality = PREV } }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_eindil_add_renown = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.165.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = {
				add = 40
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 0
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.165.c
		trigger = {
			zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_eindil.165.c_tip
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
			zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_eindil_add_renown = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		}
	}
}

# Frontier Companies Listen
# to: the Aenor realm's government; hist: Highsun 1754
country_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.167
	title = zin_eindil.167.t
	desc = zin_eindil.167.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_beat_impostor_chains
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	trigger = {
		check_variable = { zin_aenor_lost_cause > 29.999 }
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.167.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_aenor_add_lost_cause = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.167.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -5
				zin_story_rules_plausible = yes
				NOT = { zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				zin_story_rules_plausible_diverged = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_aenor_add_lost_cause = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
		}
	}
}

# The Mirror Without Its King
# to: news: every country; hist: divergence
news_event = {
	id = zin_eindil.170
	title = zin_eindil.170.t
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.170.d_lorien
		trigger = {
			has_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_eindil.170.d
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead
			}
		}
	}
	picture = GFX_zin_news_beat_heir_lost
	major = yes
	# K61: shown to the lands where it happens and the realms it involves (data/news_reach.json).
	show_major = {
		OR = {
			zin_hears_in_lands_of_the_sun = yes
			check_variable = { zin_eindil_regard > 24.999 }
		}
	}
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_eindil.170.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
	}
}
